QuestInfo.name: Secret Weapon Test
QuestInfo.1: Gold Richie's secret weapon has been completed. However, #t4032812# was lost due to Gold Richie's carelessness. It's probably somewhere nearby, so find the key, then test out the secret weapon.\n\n#i4032812##t4032812# #b#c4032812##k/1
QuestInfo.2: You found Gold Richie's Ignition Key and tested out the secret weapon. Unfortunately, the secret weapon exploded.

0.0: So, you're the helper Gold Richie sent. You came at just the right time. I'm sorry to be so blunt, but could you help me out immediately?

1.0: Ahh... It must be done quickly...
1.1: You're the helper Gold Richie sent, right? You brought the Monster Purple Crystals?

npc.0: Hurry up and obtain the Ignition Key and test the Secret Weapon.

item.0: We need #b#t4032812##k to start the system. Please obtain the Ignition Key from the nearby monsters.
